function: above_phy, p. 10: the DQN learns only task offloading and LEO-satellite user association (P3.1); uplink transmit power is solved by SCA with CVX (pp. 8-9), not learned.
notes: Title check passed: page 1 holds the title 'Joint Task Offloading and Resource Allocation for LEO Satellite-Based Mobile Edge Computing Systems With Heterogeneous Task Demands' and DOI 10.1109/TVT.2025.3549119. Reason above_phy. p. 1: the MINLP is solved by a framework that 'decomposes the original problem into two subproblems, which are solved by successive convex approximation (SCA) and deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms, respectively'. The only learned component is a DQN for task offloading and user association: p. 10, Fig. 4 'The framework of the proposed DQN-based computing offloading and user association scheme'; 'P3.1 is a complex multi-constrained 0-1 integer optimization problem that is challenging to solve. Therefore, this paper proposes a DRL-based solution'; its action (eq. 43) is the offloading decision rho_m, the satellite association beta_m,j and the offloading destination Pi_m. The physical-layer decision, the users' uplink transmit power, is not learned: p. 8 'we apply SCA to obtain a suboptimal solution of P1.1'; p. 9 'making P1.3 a convex optimization problem, which can be solved with the CVX toolbox'; the DQN only receives the optimized power p*_m in its state (p. 10). Computing resources (P2.1, p. 9) and the partial-offloading ratio (p. 11, Algorithm 2: 'Use CVX to solve problem P4.1') are also solved by convex optimization, and the GMM/EM task-utility model (pp. 6-8) models task demands, not a physical-layer function. Learning is part of the proposed method (not only motivation, baseline, or application), so no_learning is not the code; the learning acts on task offloading and user association, which Step 1 lists as above the physical layer. The satellite exception does not apply because no transmit power, radio resource, or beam is learned. Reviewer may confirm the choice of above_phy over no_learning.
